other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.intro: Welcome to firearm handling. First of all, lets pin first aid knowledge
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.medical: You know how to treat it.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.medicalCompl: Good job Experiment #{0}, now, lets move on to when you are the one firing
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.combat: Live practice: three waves. Clear each wave before the next. Ammo is replenished, but there is no automatic healing between waves.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.eject: Now eject the magazine using the magazine-release area, or your configured eject control. A chambered round can remain after the magazine is removed.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.insert: A loaded magazine is in your front pouch or beside you. Drag it onto the weapon. Close the slide to chamber a round. Loose rounds belong in the bandolier; spare magazines belong in the front pouch.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.looseRound: An empty spare magazine and loose 9mm rounds are supplied. Drag a round from the bandolier onto that magazine, or combine them in inventory. Load at least one round to continue.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.rack: Pick up the M1911. Open the slide by dragging its handle in the gun window. With the minigame disabled, use the configured rack control. An open slide is not a loaded chamber.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.range: Moving to the firing range. Training ammunition will be replenished during targets and live practice. Injuries carry through training; you receive one full recovery immediately before survival.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.reinsert: Reinsert a magazine. If the slide is locked open, close it. If it is closed on an empty chamber, cycle it. Check the fire selector: safe will prevent firing.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.survival: Training complete. You will receive one full recovery and a finite stock of guns and ammunition. No resupply, automatic healing, or medical equipment after that. Enemies keep arriving. Your score is active survival time; pauses do not count. Leave the course whenever you wish.
other.newfirearms.course.dialogue.targets: Practice with {0}. Load, chamber, select a firing mode, then destroy all three targets to your right. Other weapons do not count for this drill. Reload whenever necessary.
